title: When the House Falls
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: Kestrel Pemberton, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
